description.text: The Conqueror's inner perception of herself. She does not hide her desire to lay waste to Civilization.
Constantly protected by an Æther shield that greatly reduces the DMG taken by the enemy. Interrupt the enemy's charge-up to temporarily disable the shield.
Tears the fabric of spacetime to immobilize your operators. Try to interrupt this skill if you can.
Traps your operators with an Ankhor. Attack the Ankhor to free them.
